answer.rationale: With only one experiment slot, the highest-leverage, lowest-risk move is to address the onboarding completion decline directly, since two inherited memories (memory_31, memory_86) support signup simplification/shorter onboarding as a durable driver of activation and time-to-value. Reacting to the competitor's entry pricing with promotional_pricing is tempting given the SMB price pressure, but memory_73's evidence base is narrow (one 4-week SMB readout) and matching aggressive discounting risks eroding margins and training price-sensitive accounts to churn or downgrade later—undermining sustainable qualified revenue rather than protecting it.
